early_vote.source: ElectIndex early-vote tracker (github.com/ElectIndex/26_early_vote), latest row per state
notes: Early-vote counts are published by state, not by contest, so there is no race-by-race split. Party columns are the party registration of people who have returned ballots, where the state publishes it; 'no affiliation' is shown separately.

As-of dates differ by state (Oct 9 to Oct 18), so totals are not a same-day snapshot. 'Early' means mail ballots returned plus in-person early voting; definitions differ by state, and for some states mail plus in-person does not equal the total.
Percent of 2024 compares the 2026 count so far with each state's final 2024 early-vote total from the same tracker. It measures progress, not a forecast.
Cross-check: Call the Map (Oct 16-17) gives FL 814,687 and MD 196,082, matching the tracker. Its NC, PA, ME, IA and NV figures were a day or two older than the tracker's.

No data: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Louisiana, Missouri, New York, New Hampshire, Oregon, South Carolina, Washington and West Virginia. New York: the NYC Board of Elections page showed only June primary check-ins (to June 21) on Oct 18, and NBC's page blocks automated readers. When state and city figures differ, the New York State figure is to be used.
Very low counts (TX, UT, HI, VT, MS) may be partial or just starting; verify before relying on them.
